newsitem.title: UK: BFI down one but more enquiry noted.
newsitem.headline: BFI down one but more enquiry noted.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down one point on Tuesday to 1,283 points but brokers reported steadier conditions and more chartering enquiry in the North Atlantic and North Pacific.
Brokers also believed that Panamax rates from Brazil and Argentina may continue weak and there are also doubts about prospects for Capers in the Pacific.
In a generally quiet market the Baltic Handy Index was up two to 1,082 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 10 to 25 points higher and turnover totalled 87 lots.
